summary.matching_rule: Distinctive name key (lower-case ASCII tokens minus generic camp words, park-type words and the park name tokens) must be equal between official title and OSM name; OSM point (ledger OSM coordinate) must be inside, or within 2 km (planar degree approximation, screening) of, an OSM protected-area polygon with the same normalised name as the official park. Prior ledger official matches are also candidates. Exactly one distinct OSM feature -> coordinates; else hold. GeoPDF-derived coordinates never used. Disputed geometry (Gym Beach) held.
summary.osm_candidate_pool: SA OSM non-pitch tourism=camp_site/caravan_site features inside state boundary, excluding prior ledger child/duplicate/sub-area exclusions and review-decision exclusions
